WITH controller_stress AS (
    SELECT 
        sc.systemoverseeractuation,
        sc.overseerloadvalue,
        sc.memuseval,
        ROUND(CAST((sc.overseerloadvalue + sc.memuseval) / 2.0 AS numeric), 2) AS controller_stress_score,
        rd.modelseriesval
    FROM system_controller sc
    JOIN actuation_data ad ON sc.systemoverseeractuation = ad.actreg
    JOIN robot_record rr ON ad.actrecref = rr.botcode
    JOIN robot_details rd ON rr.botcode = rd.botdetreg
),
model_avg AS (
    SELECT modelseriesval, AVG(controller_stress_score) AS avg_stress
    FROM controller_stress
    GROUP BY modelseriesval
)
SELECT 
    cs.systemoverseeractuation,
    cs.modelseriesval,
    cs.controller_stress_score,
    ma.avg_stress,
    ROUND(CAST(cs.controller_stress_score / ma.avg_stress AS numeric), 2) AS stress_ratio
FROM controller_stress cs
JOIN model_avg ma ON cs.modelseriesval = ma.modelseriesval
WHERE cs.controller_stress_score > 1.2 * ma.avg_stress
ORDER BY stress_ratio DESC
